Snapshot of account (notes from AE/SE):
- Company: Fairgrove Retail Intelligence — marketplace for seasonal apparel and home goods. Catalog ~85M SKUs (source SKUs + variants).
- Primary ask: replace brittle keyword search + heuristics with semantic embeddings + a reranking layer that respects business signals (margin, inventory). Cost per query is the gating metric. CTO quote: "Can’t exceed $0.004/query average across peak windows."
- Performance targets: p95 latency <= 150ms for search + rerank pipeline (under normal traffic), acceptable soft-fail degrade to cached responses under peak. Throughput target ~12k QPS during Black Friday spike (expected ×6 normal).
- Indexing cadence & scale: full reindex nightly for catalog subset, incremental deltas 3x/day. Embedding vector store ~85M vectors, targeting compressed footprints via 8-bit / product quantization. Concern: vector store replication and memory cost at scale.
- Proof-of-concept: POC dataset ingested 2026-02-14 (10M representative SKUs). 2026-03-02 performance run: 120ms p95 on small cluster but cost projection exceeded target by ~35% when using off-the-shelf dense retrieval + transformer reranker.
- Technical preferences: prefer model routing (smaller embedder for recall + larger reranker on top-100 candidate set). Want autoscaling policy that supports burst capacity for sale days. Interest in Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching and quantization profiles.
- Security/compliance: SSO via Okta, SOC2 required, EU data residency for 20% of catalog and associated PII-free logs. KMS integration mandatory for private deployments.
- Stakeholders: Head of Search (Marta Liu), CTO (Andre Castillo), Product lead (Sophie Park). Marta emphasized observability for business metrics (CTR, add-to-cart delta after rerank).
- Procurement & timeline: legal reviewing standard T&Cs (procurement window opens mid-Apr). They want SLA language around p95 latency during peak for Dedicated option.
- Next technical steps: (1) Run a dedicated-cluster peak simulation (SE to provision infra) (2) Provide per-query cost breakdown with batching scenarios and top-K tradeoffs (3) Deliver a short pilot playbook for Black Friday prep including cache priming and fallback rules.
- Quick quotes from call: "If we can show a predictable $/query and a safe fallback we can go to procurement." — Marta.
- CRM shorthand: POC healthy; main risk = cost model & legal; high upside if rerank increases conversion by 4%+.
